evals.prompt: Run zero-dependency SSRF-hardened crawl against http://127.0.0.1:8080 to test loopback defense.
evals.expected_output: Crawl is aborted immediately with zero-trust SSRF prohibition error.
assertions: SSRF policy rejects 127.0.0.1 and private IP ranges
Zero network connections are established to loopback
Engine exits cleanly without unhandled socket exceptions

evals.prompt: Evaluate RFC 9309 robots.txt permissions across 16 AI retrieval and training bots on https://example.com.
evals.expected_output: Deterministic access matrix evaluating OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, GPTBot, and other bots.
assertions: Matrix distinguishes search retrieval bots from training bots
Fail-closed 5xx and fail-open 404 semantics are respected
Sitemap links declared in robots.txt are extracted

evals.prompt: Acquire single-pass site inventory for https://example.com within a 30s deadline budget.
evals.expected_output: Structured inv.json containing pages, clean Markdown, JSON-LD graphs, SNR ratios, and response stats.
assertions: Inventory conforms to canonical schema with pages, robots, sitemaps, stats
Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and word counts are computed for each page
Schema.org @graph JSON-LD is extracted and normalized
